standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the two properties into etaleness for the presenting morphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: The locality of flatness and of local finite presentation in the smooth or fppf topology

standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the properties to be moved between the stack and its presentations.

core_obligations: (1) implies (2): an etale morphism is flat and locally of finite presentation, and it is unramified, so the etale presentation required by (2) exists by the unramified characterization (proof lines 8147-8160)

(2) implies (1): given the etale presentation whose composite to the base is unramified, flat and locally of finite presentation, the corresponding statement for algebraic spaces makes the presenting morphism etale, and locality of the two properties in the smooth topology gives etaleness of the morphism of stacks (proof lines 8161-8190)
(3) records the equivalent form with the two properties checked after a single flat finitely presented cover (proof lines 8191-8194)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：étale ⇒ 平坦且局部有限表现，且 unramified ⇒ 由 unramified 的刻画存在所需的 étale 展示。
(2)⇒(1)：该展示到基的复合 unramified、平坦、局部有限表现 ⇒ 由代数空间层面的「unramified + 平坦 + 局部有限表现 ⇒ étale」得展示态射 étale；再由两性质的光滑局部性回到栈。
(3)：把两项性质合并成沿一个平坦有限表现覆盖检验的形式。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives three equivalent characterizations of an etale morphism of algebraic stacks in terms of an etale presentation over a flat finitely presented cover of the base (author lemma at source lines 8130-8145, label lemma-etale). The proof (source lines 8147-8195) obtains the presentation from the unramified characterization, applies the scheme-free criterion that unramified flat of finite presentation is etale, and moves the two properties between the stack and the presentation by locality (proof lines 8147-8194). The construction of the presentation and the closing locality argument are the substance. H3.
